query_text: I am comparing three mortgage options for a $500,000 home in Austin, Texas, with a 20% down payment. Option A: 30-year fixed at 6.5%. Option B: 15-year fixed at 5.75%. Option C: 5/1 ARM at 5.5% for the first 5 years. Calculate the monthly principal and interest for each and provide a total interest cost comparison over the full life of the loans, assuming the ARM rate increases by 2% after the initial period.

Create a detailed 2-day sightseeing itinerary for Rome, Italy, for 2024-09-15 and 2024-09-16. The traveler is staying near the Pantheon and prefers walking. Include specific time slots for the Colosseum, Vatican Museums, and Trevi Fountain, factoring in average visit durations and a maximum daily budget of 100 Euros for food and entry fees.

Recommend 5 classic cyberpunk movies released between 1982 and 1999. For each film, provide the title, director, release year, and a brief explanation of how it explores the 'high tech, low life' theme. Ensure the list includes at least one non-English language film.

I am hosting a board game night in Seattle, USA on 2024-11-15 for 6 participants. Suggest three specific board games that support exactly 6 players, have a complexity rating under 3.0/5, and take less than 90 minutes to play. Also, provide a grocery shopping list for snacks and drinks with a total budget of $60 USD.

Compare the technical specifications of the 2020 MacBook Air (M1 chip) and the 2022 MacBook Air (M2 chip). Please provide a table showing the base CPU cores, GPU cores, maximum unified memory support, and the weight in pounds for both models.

I am looking for a mineral-based sunscreen for sensitive skin. Provide a list of three highly-rated products available as of 2023 that are SPF 50 or higher, fragrance-free, and contain non-nano zinc oxide. For each, list the primary active ingredients and the typical container size in ounces.

I need to book a flight from London (LHR), UK to Tokyo (HND), Japan. Departure: 2024-11-15, Return: 2024-11-25. Passengers: 2 Adults. Class: Premium Economy. Budget: £3,500 total. Please compare these three options and recommend the best one based on shortest travel time: 1) British Airways: £3,200, 14h 30m direct. 2) Emirates: £2,800, 18h 15m via Dubai. 3) ANA: £3,450, 13h 50m direct. Provide a summary of the selection and a breakdown of the costs.

Plan a dinner reservation for a corporate group of 8 people at 'L'Ambroisie' in Paris, France on 2024-12-24 at 20:00. The budget is €400 per person. Please generate a booking confirmation summary including the restaurant address (9 Place des Vosges), the cancellation policy (48 hours notice), and a request for a quiet table suitable for business discussion.

Based on the following forecast for London, UK from 2024-10-15 to 2024-10-17: [Oct 15: 12°C, Heavy Rain; Oct 16: 10°C, Strong Winds; Oct 17: 14°C, Partly Cloudy], generate a specific packing list for a three-day business trip including appropriate footwear and outerwear.

Compare the historical average temperatures, humidity levels, and rainfall for Tokyo, Japan and Sydney, Australia during the month of July. Based on this data, explain which city is more suitable for a traveler who suffers from heat-induced asthma.

I need a visualization of my monthly household expenses for January 2024. Here is the breakdown: Rent: $1,500, Groceries: $600, Utilities: $250, Insurance: $150, Dining Out: $300, and Transport: $120. Please create a pie chart showing the percentage for each category and a summary card for total spending.

Compare the quarterly revenue of three product lines (Software, Hardware, Services) for the fiscal year 2023. Data: Q1: [Software: 45k, Hardware: 30k, Services: 20k], Q2: [48k, 28k, 22k], Q3: [52k, 35k, 25k], Q4: [60k, 40k, 30k]. Generate a grouped bar chart and identify which quarter had the highest total growth.

Create a detailed 3-day travel itinerary for Tokyo, Japan, from 2025-05-10 to 2025-05-12. The traveler is interested in anime culture, traditional temples, and high-end ramen. Include specific neighborhoods like Akihabara and Asakusa, and keep the daily budget under 15,000 JPY excluding accommodation.

Plan a 7-day ketogenic meal prep schedule for a single adult with a daily limit of 2,000 calories and 30g net carbs. Exclude all seafood and peanuts due to allergies. Provide a grocery list for a budget of $120 USD and a preparation timeline for a Sunday afternoon.

Create a detailed project timeline for a mobile application development cycle starting 2024-11-01 and ending 2025-02-15. Include phases for UI/UX design, frontend development, backend integration, and QA testing. Assign specific milestones for every three weeks.

Analyze the following monthly household budget and suggest three areas to save at least $200 total: Rent: $2,100, Groceries: $650, Dining Out: $400, Utilities: $280, Internet: $80, Streaming Services: $120, Gym: $100, Transportation: $350, Miscellaneous: $200.

Provide a traditional Italian Bolognese sauce recipe that serves 4 people. Include a list of ingredients in metric units (grams/milliliters) and step-by-step instructions for a 3-hour slow simmer process.

Create a 5-day meal prep plan for a ketogenic diet focusing on high-fat, moderate-protein, and under 20g net carbs per day. Include a complete shopping list for a single person and estimated preparation times for each meal.
Compare the average high and low temperatures for London, UK and Madrid, Spain during the month of July based on historical climate data. Present the results in a table.

I am planning a trip to Tokyo, Japan from 2025-05-15 to 2025-05-20. Provide a 5-day itinerary focusing on the Shinjuku and Shibuya districts, including three specific restaurant recommendations with a budget of $50 per person per meal.

How do I fix a #VLOOKUP error in Microsoft Excel when the lookup value exists in the source table but is formatted as text while the source table contains numbers? Provide a formula-based solution and a formatting-based solution.

I have a Linksys EA8300 router. Provide a step-by-step guide to changing the SSID name and the WPA2 security password. Include the default local IP address and the standard administrative username used to access the web interface.

Write a short story about a clockmaker in Prague, Czech Republic, who discovers a watch that can stop time for exactly five seconds. The story should be set in the year 1895 and include a scene where he uses the watch to prevent a minor accident in his shop.

Create a detailed character profile for a protagonist in a cyberpunk novel. Include their name, age, physical description, a unique cybernetic enhancement, their occupation as a freelance data courier in Neo-Tokyo, and a 300-word backstory explaining why they are in debt to a local syndicate.

Create a plot outline for a murder mystery novel set on a luxury train traveling from Paris to Istanbul in the year 1935. Include the victim, the murder weapon, three suspects with motives, and the final plot twist.

Create a detailed hourly itinerary for a one-day corporate leadership workshop held on 2024-11-15 in Chicago, USA. The event starts at 08:30 and ends at 17:00. Include slots for a keynote speech, three breakout sessions (strategy, communication, and innovation), a catered lunch at 12:30, and a closing networking mixer. Specify the room assignments for each session assuming a 3-room venue (Grand Ballroom, Maple Room, and Oak Room).

Generate a 3-day music festival schedule for 'Echoes of Summer' taking place in Austin, Texas from 2025-07-11 to 2025-07-13. There are two stages: Main Stage and Indie Grove. Include 4 acts per stage per day, starting at 14:00 and ending at 23:00. Provide a mix of genres like Synth-pop, Indie Rock, and Folk. Ensure no two acts on the same stage overlap.

Construct a 'Home Renovation' schedule for a kitchen remodel from 2024-05-01 to 2024-05-15. Timeline: Days 1-2: Demolition. Days 3-5: Electrical and Plumbing. Days 6-8: Cabinet Installation. Days 9-10: Countertop Templating/Install. Days 11-13: Flooring. Days 14-15: Backsplash and Painting. List specific dates for each phase.

Analyze the historical performance of the S&P 500 versus Gold from January 1, 2000, to December 31, 2020. Provide a summary of the total percentage growth for both assets, identify which had higher volatility, and list the three most significant market crashes that occurred during this specific timeframe.

Compare the nutritional profiles of 100g of raw kale, 100g of raw spinach, and 100g of Swiss chard. Specifically, create a table showing calories, Vitamin A, Vitamin K, Vitamin C, and Calcium content for each, then provide a brief research summary on which leafy green is most beneficial for bone density based on these values.
Compare the nutritional profiles of 100g of cooked quinoa versus 100g of cooked brown rice, specifically looking at protein content, fiber, and glycemic index.

I am choosing between two credit cards. Card A: 2% cashback on all purchases, no annual fee. Card B: 4% cashback on dining/travel, 1% on everything else, $95 annual fee. Based on a monthly spend of $500 on dining, $200 on travel, and $1,300 on other categories, which card yields a higher net value after one year?

Calculate the monthly mortgage payment for a home priced at $450,000 with a 20% down payment, an annual interest rate of 6.25%, and a loan term of 30 years. Please also provide the total interest paid over the life of the loan.

I have a rectangular room that is 14 feet long and 12 feet wide. The ceiling height is 8 feet. I want to paint the four walls with two coats of paint. If one gallon of paint covers 350 square feet, how many gallons do I need to purchase? Do not subtract for windows or doors.
Convert a temperature of 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit to Celsius and Kelvin. Show the step-by-step formulas used for the conversion.

Create a detailed 5-day itinerary for a family of four (two adults, two children aged 8 and 10) visiting Tokyo, Japan from 2025-06-10 to 2025-06-15. The focus should be on anime, interactive technology, and kid-friendly museums. Include estimated daily costs in USD and specific neighborhoods for each day.

Provide a comprehensive packing list for a 10-day trekking expedition to the Everest Base Camp, Nepal, during the month of October. Categorize the list into clothing, gear, hygiene, and first-aid, specifically accounting for temperatures ranging from -10°C to 15°C.

I am planning a walking tour of the historic center in Rome, Italy, for 2025-05-15. Please provide a step-by-step route starting at the Colosseum at 09:00, visiting the Roman Forum, the Pantheon, and ending at Piazza Navona by 17:00. Include estimated walking times between each stop and a 1-hour break for lunch near the Pantheon.

Compare these three flight options from London (LHR) to New York (JFK) for 2024-11-10. Option A: British Airways, $650, 08:30 departure, direct. Option B: Virgin Atlantic, $720, 11:00 departure, direct. Option C: Air France, $510, 07:00 departure, 1 stop in Paris (2h layover). Rank them based on price and then by shortest travel duration.

Create a 4-week study schedule for the SAT Math section, assuming I can dedicate 1 hour every weekday and 3 hours on Saturdays. Focus on Algebra, Problem Solving, Data Analysis, and Passport to Advanced Math. Include specific topics for each day.

Provide a complete conjugation table for the Spanish verb 'escribir' (to write) in the following tenses: Present, Preterite, Imperfect, Future, and Conditional. Include the pronouns: yo, tú, él/ella/usted, nosotros, vosotros, and ellos/ellas/ustedes.

I have a JSON object representing a user profile: {"id": 102, "name": "Alice Smith", "roles": ["admin", "editor"], "last_login": "2023-11-15T08:30:00Z", "settings": {"theme": "dark", "notifications": true}}. Please generate a technical documentation table that describes each key, its data type, and a brief description of its purpose.

Summarize the following 'Flexible Work Policy' into five bullet points for an employee handbook: 'Employees may work remotely up to three days per week. Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 EST, during which all staff must be available. Requests for remote days must be submitted via the HR portal by Friday of the preceding week. Equipment stipends of $500 are provided annually. Travel to the New York, USA office is required once per quarter for team synchronization.'

Create a music player interface for the song 'Echoes of Silence' by the artist 'Lumina'. Include a progress bar at 1:24 out of 3:45, play/pause controls, a shuffle toggle that is currently active, and a volume slider set to 70%. Display the album art as a placeholder square.

Design a video player dashboard for a streaming service. The current video is 'Nature Documentary: The Deep Sea', 1080p resolution, with subtitles enabled in English. Provide a layout that includes a 'Next Episode' overlay button, a settings gear for quality selection, and a 'Skip Intro' button currently appearing at the 02:15 mark.

Design a mobile UI layout for a QR code scanner application. The screen should include a central scanning viewfinder, a toggle for the camera flash, a button to upload an image from the gallery, and a navigation bar with icons for 'Scan', 'History', and 'Settings'.

I have a raw string extracted from a Wi-Fi QR code: 'WIFI:S:CoffeeShop_Guest;T:WPA;P:LatteArt2024;H:false;;'. Parse this data and present it in a clean, user-friendly card format that shows the Network Name, Security Type, and Password, with a 'Connect Now' button.

Analyze the following weather data for Tokyo, Japan, from 2024-06-10 to 2024-06-12: [June 10: 28°C, 80% humidity, Heavy Rain; June 11: 26°C, 75% humidity, Light Showers; June 12: 24°C, 60% humidity, Partly Cloudy]. Based on this, determine which day is most suitable for an outdoor photography session and provide a brief status summary of the conditions.

I am tracking three packages with the following statuses as of 2024-05-20: 1) ID: 94001, Status: Out for Delivery in Chicago, IL, USA. 2) ID: 94002, Status: In Transit, arrived at sorting facility in Memphis, TN, USA. 3) ID: 94003, Status: Label Created, pending pickup in Seattle, WA, USA. Summarize the current status of my shipments and estimate which will arrive first.

Review the project status for 'Website Redesign' as of 2024-03-01. Tasks: [UI Mockups: Completed; Backend API: In Progress (60%); Content Migration: Not Started; QA Testing: Blocked by Backend]. Provide a health status report for the project and identify the primary bottleneck.
